notes.title: Original Soundtrack Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Since release we've been working behind the scenes and now have a couple of exciting new things to share with you all!

[h2]💿 The Original Soundtrack is Out Now![/h2]
The Death Trick: Double Blind OST, composed by KALA & Dana Kendall, is available to buy now! 
Featuring all 21 tracks from the game, you can get it it here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2660450?utm_source=ostannouncement&utm_medium=web

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2660450?utm_source=ostannouncement&utm_medium=web][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43435838/983bbadb4bfd71d2f6bc3fbf8f08e96ffed9e57f.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Deluxe Edition Includes OST![/h2]
The deluxe edition has been upgraded, and now includes both the OST and the Artbook for Death Trick: Double Blind!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39517/Death_Trick_Double_Blind_Deluxe_Edtion/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39517/Death_Trick_Double_Blind_Deluxe_Edtion/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43435838/c383b2ba3104bb46eceb9b1a0947fb7e2ffb5e3f.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Community Items Are Live![/h2]
Finally, we are excited to announce that you can now earn Death Trick: Double Blind Steam Trading Cards. So get yourself a full set to unlock our exclusive DTDB themed backgrounds, emoticons, and a shiny badge for your profile! 

Thank you all so much for the support and love you have been giving to Death Trick: Double Blind so far, and happy sleuthing!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.16 [Moving locations no longer costs AP]
notes.content:
[Design Change] 
- Following player feedback, after some consideration, we made it so that moving location in the game *no longer* costs AP. We hope this will make gameplay smoother and give you the chance to explore more stories in the game!

[Changes]
- Following the AP change, tutorial has been changed accordingly, and slight changes have been made to the 10am Moses scene to accommodate for more actions. 

[Bug Fixes]
- Fixed a bug where the sunset background was incorrectly displayed for the Fair scene when the player ends 12:00 Detective scene in Fortune Teller or Big Top
- Fixed a bug where opening and quickly closing the map will leave the scene silent without BGM
- Fixed minor typos in English
- Fixed wrong controller button instructions for log on the bottom right of the controller UI
- Disabled resizable window to prevent resolution issues

notes.title: Play Our Demo During Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h2]We're excited to announce that the Death Trick: Double Blind Demo will be playable throughout Steam Next Fest! 🔍🎉[/h2]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2254710/Death_Trick_Double_Blind/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43435838/2e8d0b77293ddbb792717c3c325303f0d39a4227.png[/img]

From now until the 12th of February, the Death Trick: Double Blind demo remains playable for all our burgeoning sleuths and detectives. So don't miss out on this opportunity to get a taste of the exciting and intriguing mystery around the disappearance of [b]The Amazing Hattie[/b]... 

[b][i]Who holds the truth among the vibrant cast of Death Trick: Double Blind? Uncover hidden secrets, unravel lies, and expose the responsible party in this immersive and immersive experience. Get ready to be captivated![/i][/b]

But that's not all!
The team worked hard to bring you an updated and magically enhanced new version of the demo:

[list]
[*] Expanded into three turns from the original two turns
[*] New Task System
[*] Can use EXP to raise AP limit from Tito
[*] Can see which characters are available on the map
[*] New dialogue & comics
[*] [u]Controller support[/u]
[/list]

notes.title: Solve the Case in Death Trick: Double Blind: New Demo, Livestream, and Playtest
notes.content:
[h2]Attention all sleuths and investigators,[/h2]

We have an important announcement to make regarding our upcoming investigative visual novel, Death Trick: Double Blind. As we just unveiled our game at the highly anticipated LudoNarra Con event, we have some thrilling updates to share with you.

[list]
[*] We are delighted to announce that we have partnered with Neon Doctrine, our trusted partner in crime, to help us bring Death Trick: Double Blind to life. With their support, we have created a new demo that is now available for download on Steam, providing you with a glimpse of the suspense and intrigue that awaits you in our game.
[/list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/pub/nd][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43435838/c56ca2e47d427edb1e8fcde3d534e7aed94baa09.gif[/img][/url]

[list]
[*] But that's not all. We are also excited to reveal that we have a new trailer for Death Trick: Double Blind, which will be released as part of our special announcement. The trailer will offer a tantalizing glimpse into the world of our game, teasing the mysteries and secrets that players will uncover.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=skx1lV6syBk;full][/previewyoutube]


[list]
[*] As part of our ongoing investigation into Death Trick: Double Blind, we are inviting you to join us for a special livestream event. Here, we will take a deep dive into the making of the game, examining its intricate plot, the twists and turns that you can expect, and the inspiration behind its unique art deco style.
[/list]

[b]Stream Right Here⬇️⬇️⬇️[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2254710/view/3728460016077618027][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43435838/a8b60767fd98c34e52d0211ce71a981ae76b3e64.png[/img][/url]


[list]
[*] But that's not all. We are also inviting you to participate in a special Playtest, where you can help us solve the mystery by providing your feedback and insights into the game. As a reward for your valuable contributions, we will credit you in the game's final version.
[/list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2254710/Death_Trick_Double_Blind/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43435838/aacfaedc7be70642a8593b67359fd4ac3f267cca.png[/img][/url]

[i]We can't wait to share more details about Death Trick: Double Blind with you in the future. Stay tuned for further updates, and we hope you have what it takes to crack the case and uncover the truth behind this gripping murder mystery.[/i]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2254710/Death_Trick_Double_Blind/

notes.title: Development Update (& Eastern Games Fest Announcement)
notes.content:
Hi fellow detectives,

We are excited to share that Death Trick: Double Blind is a part of Eastern games fest, hosted by Steam China! 

Click here ↓ to add it to your wishlist now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2254710/Death_Trick_Double_Blind/


We also want to share some [b]updates[/b] on what we've been busy with lately:

We've just completed a small [b]beta playtest[/b] with some players in our great community, and collected a lot of valuable feedback. 

We have been working to make some changes and adjustments according to the beta test feedback, as well as working on a [b]brand new trailer[/b] to be released with the demo. We are making great progress with both and rest assured you will see our brand new demo and trailer within a month ([i]promise![/i])

At the same time, we've also started slowly updating all of our art assets to [b]4k[/b] for the future complete version of the game, so you will be able to enjoy the game in higher resolution if you wish :)

For now, see you in Eastern games fest :)
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/easterngamesfest
